description: Cozy renovated flat right next to the Main Building. Perfect for medical students who need quick access to the clinics. The windows face a quiet park.
Affordable studio near Ótemető street. Ideal for engineering students. Low utility costs due to new insulation. Small but very functional layout.
Modern two-bedroom apartment near Kassai road. Great for CS and Law students sharing. Includes a large balcony and air conditioning.
Spacious luxury apartment in the Nagyerdő area. A bit of a walk to the tram, but very peaceful. Huge living room, perfect for social gatherings.
Unfurnished classic civic apartment downtown. High ceilings and wooden floors. 2 minutes from the tram line 1 stop.
Budget-friendly garzon for a single student. Located on Csapó street, easy bus access to Engineering faculty. Minimalist style.
Sunny flat near the Clinics. Fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher. Tram line 1 stops right in front of the building.
Newly built condominium complex. Gated community with security. Two separate bedrooms, ideal for roommates studying at the main university.
Stylish loft apartment near the swimming complex. Open concept design. Very close to the IT and Law buildings on Kassai.
Quiet ground floor apartment in a garden suburb area. Best for someone with a bike or car, as the bus stop is a 10-minute walk.
Huge premium apartment overlooking the University Church. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms. High-end furniture and dedicated study spaces.
Nice flat on Bem tér. Direct trolley connection to Kassai campus. Surrounded by bakeries and cafes.
Unfurnished 2-room flat on Egyetem sugárút. You can bring your own furniture. Very classic atmosphere with large windows.
Located in the heart of the city near the Forum mall. Noisy but vibrant location. Excellent transport links to everywhere.
Compact efficiency apartment. Cheap utilities and rent. Walking distance to the Engineering faculty library.
Two-bedroom flat perfect for two med students. Located on Simonyi street. The tram stop is literally at the gate.
Renovated panel apartment. Very warm in winter (district heating). 5 minutes tram ride to the Main Building.
Modern penthouse-style top floor apartment. AC in every room. Huge terrace with a view of the stadium.
Nice civic flat near Plaza. Good for students who want to be near the city center nightlife but study at Kassai.
Three bedroom student hostel style apartment. Each room has its own lock. Shared large kitchen and living area.
Simple, clean flat on Faraktár street. Direct bus to the Engineering faculty. Grocery store is downstairs.
Bright and airy apartment on Nagyerdei körút. You can jog in the forest every morning. Very quiet and focused environment.
Newly renovated 2-bedroom in a brick building. Quiet courtyard view. 10 minute walk to the Campus.
One bedroom plus a half room for storage or guests. Located on Füredi street. Easy tram access to university.
Massive 4-bedroom apartment for a group of friends. High-end finishings, two bathrooms, huge American kitchen.
Artist friendly flat downtown. High ceilings, good natural light. Close to the theater and music faculty.
Comfortable flat near the sports pool. Ground floor, easy access. Includes a dedicated parking spot.
Two large bedrooms with king size beds. On the tram line. Includes weekly cleaning service in the price.
Super modern aesthetic. LED lighting, smart home features. Located right behind the Main Building.
Small but cozy garzon. Low overhead costs. Friendly landlord who speaks English.
Spacious flat on Kassai road. Soundproof windows so the traffic noise isn't an issue. Big wardrobes.
Retro style apartment but very clean. Located in the 'U' building shape near the uni. Good community.
Luxury apartment near the clinics. Modern kitchen appliances. Perfect for international students.
Located on Piac street. Steps away from everything. The windows face the inner yard so it is surprisingly quiet.
Nice flat in a quiet street off Ótemető. No direct bus in front, but a 5 minute walk. Very safe neighborhood.
Premium 2-bedroom in the new residential park. Gym and sauna in the building for residents.
Standard student flat. Desk and chair provided. Reliable internet included in the rent.
Nice layout with separate rooms. Ideal for privacy. Located on the boulevard, very central.
Cozy attic apartment. Skylights make it very bright. AC installed for the summer heat.
Pet friendly apartment! If you have a small dog or cat, this is perfect. Near the Great Forest for walks.
Renovated brick apartment. Very thick walls, totally silent. Great for studying. Close to Főnix.
Cheap and cheerful. Basic furniture but everything works. Close to Lidl and Penny Market.
Spacious flat with a bathtub. Washing machine and dryer included. 5 mins to the Medical School.
Located in the 'French' building. Nice balcony. Very popular area for students.
Three bedroom flat perfect for Erasmus students. Fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher and microwave.
Neat flat near Bem tér. Easy connection to both Kassai and Main campus via public transport.
Designer apartment. Very stylish furniture. Open kitchen living room area. Great for hosting dinners.
Ground floor apartment with direct garden access. Rare find in the city. Very relaxing atmosphere.
Renovated panel flat. LED lights, new flooring. Very clean and tidy.
Two bedroom flat on Bolyai street. Super close to the uni. You can literally roll out of bed into class.
